local data={
	["Originium Ore"]={name="Originium Ore", tier=1, use="A raw formation of Originium unearthed in its most natural form. This can be processed in the AIC.", desc="A basic mineral necessary to support most industrial production.", obtain="Exploration and Gathering"},
	["Amethyst Ore"]={name="Amethyst Ore", tier=1, use="An ore containing a purple colored crystalline material. It can be processed with the AIC.", desc="Amethyst has a wide range of uses in precision manufacturing. The crystal is one of the essential basic materials in the electronic industry of Talos-II.", obtain="Exploration and Gathering"},
	["Ferrium Ore"]={name="Ferrium Ore", tier=1, use="A natural-occurring metal complex with blue coloration. 	["Cuprium Ore"]={name="Cuprium Ore", tier=1, use="A reddish metal that can be processed with the AIC.", desc="A natural mineral complex unique to the Jinlong region. Metals acquired by refining this ore form the basis for local industry and production.", obtain="Exploration and Gathering"},
	["Cyanite Ore"]={name="Cyanite Ore", tier=1, use="An agglomerate of ore with rusty hues. It can be processed with the AIC.", desc="To be added", obtain="Unobtainable as of Beta Test"},
	["Buckflower"]={name="Buckflower", tier=1, use="A plant with brightly colored flowers that can be gathered from the wilderness or planted in the AIC. 	["Buckflower Seed"]={name="Buckflower Seed", tier=1, use="A seed of the Buckflower. 	["Citrome"]={name="Citrome", tier=1, use="A fruit that can be gathered from the wilderness or planted in the AIC. 	["Citrome Seed"]={name="Citrome Seed", tier=1, use="A seed of the Citrome. 	["Sandleaf"]={name="Sandleaf", tier=1, use="A plant with extremely rough leaves that can be gathered from the wilderness or cultivated in the AIC. 	["Sandleaf Seed"]={name="Sandleaf Seed", tier=1, use="A seed of the Sandleaf. Can be cultivated on Sandleaf Plots to grow the eponymous plant.", desc="The history of wilderness crafting can be traced back nearly a century ago. 	["Aketine"]={name="Aketine", tier=1, use="A plant that can be gathered from the wilderness or cultivated in the AIC. It usually grows at places with unique soil composition.", obtain="Exploration and Gathering"},
	["Aketine Seed"]={name="Aketine Seed", tier=1, use="A seed of the Aketine. Can be cultivated on Aketine Plots to grow the eponymous plant.", desc="Nitrates can be extracted from Aketine. 	["Wood"]={name="Wood", tier=1, use="Common wood that can be gathered in the Mossfield region. Can be used to produce Gears below Level 10.", desc="Let's chop down some trees first.", obtain="Exploration and Gathering"},
	["Firebuckle"]={name="Firebuckle", tier=2, use="A plant with extremely brightly colored flowers that grows in the wild. Can be used for treatment and the making of fine food and medicine (Fine F&M). 	["Umbraline"]={name="Umbraline", tier=2, use="A plant with special fruits that grows in the wild. Can be used for treatment and the making of fine food and medicine (Fine F&M). 	["Reed Rye Seed"]={name="Reed Rye Seed", tier=2, use="Cultivate the seeds on available Reed Rye Plots to raise the crop.", desc="Reed Rye seeds carefully selected for their generous size and vitality.", obtain="AIC Manufacturing"},

	["Redjade Ginseng"]={name="Redjade Ginseng", tier=2, use="Can be directly used in making quality food and pharmaceuticals.", desc="Redjade Ginseng is a mild herb often consumed by people in Hongshan as a fortifying supplement.", obtain="Exploration and Gathering, Farming"},
	["Redjade Ginseng Seed"]={name="Redjade Ginseng Seed", tier=2, use="Cultivate the seeds on available Redjade Ginseng Plots to raise the crop.", desc="Redjade Ginseng seeds carefully selected for their generous size and vitality.", obtain="AIC Manufacturing"},
	["Amber Rice"]={name="Amber Rice", tier=2, use="Can be directly used in making quality food and pharmaceuticals.", desc="The rounded, jade-like endosperm of the Amber Rice is also regarded as \"amber pearls.\"", obtain="Exploration and Gathering, Farming"},
	["Amber Rice Seed"]={name="Amber Rice Seed", tier=2, use="Cultivate the seeds on available Amber Rice Plots to raise the crop.", desc="Amber Rice seeds carefully selected for their generous size and vitality", obtain="AIC Manufacturing"},
	["Clean Water"]={name="Clean Water", tier=1, use="Pure and clean water. It has plenty of uses in the AIC.", desc="It has always been the source of life.", obtain="Exploration and Gathering"},
	["Sewage"]={name="Sewage", tier=2, use="Waste water containing plenty of contaminants. 	["Jincao"]={name="Jincao", tier=1, use="A plant that can be gathered from the wilderness or planted in the AIC. 	["Jincao Seed"]={name="Jincao Seed", tier=1, use="Cultivate the seeds in Jincao Plots with plenty of Clean Water to grow Jincao.", desc="Children in the frontier enjoy blowing two jincao leaves placed together to give off a sound that resembles a roaring beast.", obtain="AIC Manufacturing"},

	["Yazhen"]={name="Yazhen", tier=1, use="A flowering plant that can be gathered from the wilderness or planted in the AIC.
